note: Tempo: a music player. Playlists, a library of 3,000 songs in a table, albums and artists in a grid, search, a queue to reorder by dragging or with Alt and the arrows, now playing with a visualiser of the spectrum of what plays and lyrics, an equaliser on a curves control, crossfade and a mini player; light and dark themes, English, Spanish and French. Cmd+P finds a song and Cmd+Shift+P runs any command. Space plays or pauses, the arrows skip and set the volume, Cmd+L, Cmd+2, Cmd+3, Cmd+4 (the liked songs), Cmd+F, Cmd+5 and Cmd+6 change the page, Cmd+U shows the queue, Cmd+M the mini player, Cmd+T switches light and dark and Cmd+Shift+L the language; Cmd+S shuffles, Cmd+R repeats all or one song, Cmd+Alt+Down mutes, Cmd+[ and Cmd+] go back and forward through the pages, and a click on a line of the lyrics goes there. The heart in the player likes the song playing; a right click (or Shift+F10) on a song opens its menu: play, play next, add to the queue, like. The songs are simulated; what plays is one beatbox loop (audio/beatbox.wav, made by audio/make_beat.py), on hosts that give the screen sound. A song may have a sound of its own: its "sound" (a track's in state.playlists[i].tracks[j], a library row's in state.library[i]) names a sound of the audio section, e.g. { "file": "asset:song.mp3", "into": "state.sounds.own" } for an asset the person attached, and playing that song plays it instead of the beat. The equaliser and the crossfade are visual only: they don't change the sound.

beat.note: The sound of a song without a sound of its own: a beatbox loop made for Tempo (audio/make_beat.py)

playback.crossfade.title: Crossfade
playback.crossfade.description: How many seconds the end of a song overlaps the start of the next; 0 for none.

songs.title: Songs
songs.note: The library, made once from the word lists when the app first starts (buildLibrary)

sound.note: The name of a declared audio sound that plays for it (e.g. one whose file is an asset:); none: the beat

seed.name: Late Night Code
seed.description: Low-key beats for long sessions. Updated every Friday.

seed.name: Morning Run
seed.description: Fast, bright and loud. 160 bpm and up.

seed.name: Sunday Jazz
seed.description: Slow standards and new takes on old tunes.

computed.library: {{map(data.songs, { id: it.id, cells: [it.number, it.title, it.artist, it.album, it.time], sound: it.sound })}}
computed.queueSongs: {{map(filter(map(state.queue, { key: it, list: number(split(it, ':')[0]), track: number(split(it, ':')[1]) }), it.list < 0 ? it.track < length(computed.library) : it.track < (computed.listSizes[it.list] ?? 0)), merge(it, it.list < 0 ? { title: computed.library[it.track].cells[1], artist: computed.library[it.track].cells[2] } : { title: data.playlists[it.list].tracks[it.track].title, artist: data.playlists[it.list].tracks[it.track].artist }))}}
computed.picks: {{state.quickPick.open ? map(computed.library, { title: it.cells[1], detail: it.cells[2] + ' · ' + it.cells[3], track: index }) : []}}
computed.songMenuSong: {{state.songMenu.list < 0 ? merge({ title: computed.library[state.songMenu.track].cells[1], artist: computed.library[state.songMenu.track].cells[2], album: computed.library[state.songMenu.track].cells[3], time: computed.library[state.songMenu.track].cells[4] }, computed.library[state.songMenu.track].sound == null ? {} : { sound: computed.library[state.songMenu.track].sound }) : data.playlists[state.songMenu.list].tracks[state.songMenu.track]}}
computed.songMenuItems: {{concat([{ title: t('song.play'), run: 'play', with: { list: state.songMenu.list, track: state.songMenu.track } }, { title: t('song.playNext'), run: 'playNext', with: { key: computed.songMenuKey } }, { title: t('song.addToQueue'), run: 'addToQueue', with: { key: computed.songMenuKey } }, { separator: true }, { title: t('song.addToPlaylist'), submenu: concat(map(data.playlists, { title: it.name, enabled: index != state.songMenu.list, run: 'addToPlaylist', with: { list: index } }), [{ separator: true }, { title: t('playlist.new'), run: 'newPlaylist', with: { withSong: true } }]) }, { title: t(contains(state.liked, computed.songMenuKey) ? 'song.unlike' : 'song.like'), run: 'toggleLike', with: { key: computed.songMenuKey } }], state.songMenu.list < 0 ? [] : [{ title: t('song.remove'), run: 'removeFromPlaylist', with: { list: state.songMenu.list, track: state.songMenu.track } }])}}
computed.listMenuItems: {{[{ title: t('playlist.rename'), run: 'startRename' }, { title: t('playlist.delete'), run: 'askDelete' }]}}
computed.palette: {{map(filter(commands, it.enabled), { title: it.title, detail: it.key ? join(map(split(it.key, '+'), it == 'mod' ? 'Cmd' : upper(slice(it, 0, 1)) + slice(it, 1)), '+') : it.category, run: it.name })}}

startList.note: with: list (-1 for the library), track, source (the album or artist it plays from, or ''), rest (the queue after it, as list:track keys)

playKey.note: with: key, a song as list:track (list -1 for the library): it plays from the start

play.note: with: list, track; the queue is the songs after it, up to 50

advance.note: with: at, where the next song starts. The queue's first song plays; with an empty queue, the songs start again when repeating all, else playback stops. Songs no longer there (a playlist changed) leave the queue first

previous.note: Past the first seconds, or on the first song, the song starts again; else the song before it in the order plays, and this one comes next

tick.note: Each second while playing; at the end of a song the next starts, past the crossfade's seconds that overlapped

tick.if: {{settings.playback.crossfade > 0 && state.soundOn != '' && state.repeat != 'one' && length(state.queue) > 0 && state.elapsed == computed.duration - settings.playback.crossfade}}

replay.note: The song playing, again from the start (repeating one)

openSongMenu.note: with: list, track: the song's menu at the pointer (or by the focused row, for Shift+F10)

openPickMenu.note: with: pick, the library song a table has selected (a right click selects the row under the pointer), or null

playNext.note: with: key, any song as list:track: it comes next

addToQueue.note: with: key, any song as list:track: it goes to the end of the queue

toggleLike.note: with: key, a song as list:track (list -1 for the library)

seekLyric.note: with: offset, the lines from the current one (-2 to 2): the song goes to where that line starts

placeChanged.note: The page, the playlist or the album shown changed: the place before goes on the back stack, unless going back or forward moved there

placeChanged.to: {{merge({ page: state.page }, { current: state.current, collection: state.collection })}}

goTo.note: with: place, from the back or forward stack

jumpTo.note: A song of the queue opened: it plays, and the songs before it leave the queue

placeQueued.note: with: song (its key), at: moves a song of the queue to that place

moveQueued.note: with: by, -1 or 1: moves the song picked in the queue up or down

dropQueued.note: A song dragged within the queue: it lands before or after the row under the pointer, or last past the rows

with.at: {{event.id == null ? length(state.queue) - 1 : indexOf(filter(state.queue, it != event.data.id), event.id) + (event.place == 'after' ? 1 : 0)}}

playFromLibrary.note: A library row opened: its id is the song's place in the library

playFromPick.note: with: item, a quick pick row

newPlaylist.note: with: withSong: a new playlist opens with its name ready to type (Enter on an empty field keeps the one it has); it holds the song of the song menu when withSong

addToPlaylist.note: with: list: the song of the song menu goes to the end of that playlist

removeFromPlaylist.note: with: list, track: the song leaves the playlist; the liked songs, the queue and the song playing follow the places that moved

removeFromPlaylist.to: {{map(filter(state.liked, it != list + ':' + track), number(split(it, ':')[0]) == list && number(split(it, ':')[1]) > track ? list + ':' + (number(split(it, ':')[1]) - 1) : it)}}
{{map(filter(state.queue, it != list + ':' + track), number(split(it, ':')[0]) == list && number(split(it, ':')[1]) > track ? list + ':' + (number(split(it, ':')[1]) - 1) : it)}}

{{map(filter(state.order, it != list + ':' + track || it == computed.playingKey), number(split(it, ':')[0]) == list && number(split(it, ':')[1]) > track ? list + ':' + (number(split(it, ':')[1]) - 1) : it)}}

openListMenu.note: The menu of the playlist shown: rename, delete

renameList.note: The name typed in the header: the playlist takes it, unless it is empty

deleteList.note: with: list: the playlist goes; the liked songs, the queue and the playing list follow the lists that moved, and going back starts again

deleteList.to: {{map(filter(state.liked, number(split(it, ':')[0]) != list), number(split(it, ':')[0]) > list ? (number(split(it, ':')[0]) - 1) + ':' + split(it, ':')[1] : it)}}
{{map(filter(state.queue, number(split(it, ':')[0]) != list), number(split(it, ':')[0]) > list ? (number(split(it, ':')[0]) - 1) + ':' + split(it, ':')[1] : it)}}
{{map(filter(state.order, number(split(it, ':')[0]) != list), number(split(it, ':')[0]) > list ? (number(split(it, ':')[0]) - 1) + ':' + split(it, ':')[1] : it)}}
{{merge({ page: state.page }, { current: state.current, collection: state.collection })}}

liftAssistant.note: The assistant's button sits above the floating player (none in the mini player)

buildLibrary.note: Makes the library's 3,000 songs once, from the word lists: the first time the app starts

then.values: {{map(range(3000), { id: text(index), number: index + 1, title: state.words.adjectives[index % 16] + ' ' + state.words.nouns[floor(index / 16) % 20] + (index < 320 ? '' : ' (' + state.words.versions[floor(index / 320) - 1] + ')'), artist: state.words.artists[(index * 7) % 12], album: state.words.albums[floor(index / 5) % 18], time: floor((150 + (index * 37) % 210) / 60) + ':' + pad((150 + (index * 37) % 210) % 60, 2) })}}

do.note: Tempo opens playing, silently: the first press starts the song's sound; without sound (a host that gives none) it pauses

startSound.note: Plays the sound of the song playing (computed.sound: its own, else the beat), stopping the one before; state.soundOn names the one started, empty when none could

songChanged.note: A new song: its sound from the start while playing (the same sound again, or another one). After a crossfade (the song starts past 0) it fades in over the crossfade's seconds, as the song before faded out

do.note: The songs up next, shuffled, or back in their order (the songs added to the queue after them)

do.to: {{state.shuffle ? sort(state.queue, (number(split(it, ':')[1]) * 7919 + state.shuffleSeed) % 1009) : concat(filter(state.order, contains(state.queue, it)), filter(state.queue, !contains(state.order, it)))}}

state.isPlaying.note: The song's sound follows the player: play and pause, a new song starts it again, the volume slider sets it. A host without sound fails these quietly
